newsitem.title: CHINA: China rolled steel market seen sluggish in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China rolled steel market seen sluggish in 1996.

text.p: Chinese supply of rolled steel is expected to generally exceed demand until the end of the year and the market is likely to remain sluggish, the Economic Daily said on Thursday.
Ministry of Metallurgical Industry statistics showed steel output from January to July had risen to 48.78 million tonnes, up 5.22 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.

Steel imports in the first seven months surged a year-on-year 24.2 percent to 9.14 million tonnes, as deep cuts in customs duty introduced in the second quarter slashed the price advantage enjoyed by domestic steel, the newspaper said.
Exports from January to July were only 2.17 million tonnes, down by 37.5 percent compared with same period of 1995.
Sales ratios had also declined, as the sluggish market kept stockpiles high, the Economic Daily said but gave no details of total demand.
